```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE)
library(dplyr); library(lubridate); library(knitr)

CAPITAL <- 7206.50

trades <- read.csv("C:/Users/solis/Downloads/classic strategies/orb_trades.csv")
trades$date <- as.Date(trades$date)

meses_es <- c("Enero","Febrero","Marzo","Abril","Mayo","Junio",
              "Julio","Agosto","Septiembre","Octubre","Noviembre","Diciembre")

monthly <- trades %>%
  mutate(year = year(date), month_num = month(date)) %>%
  group_by(year, month_num) %>%
  summarise(
    pnl      = sum(pnl_usd),
    n_trades = n(),
    wr       = mean(pnl_usd > 0) * 100,
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(year, month_num) %>%
  mutate(
    Mes        = paste(meses_es[month_num], year),
    `P&L USD`  = sprintf("%+.2f", pnl),
    `Retorno`  = sprintf("%+.2f%%", pnl / CAPITAL * 100),
    `Trades`   = n_trades,
    `Win Rate` = sprintf("%.0f%%", wr),
    `Resultado` = ifelse(pnl > 0, "Positivo", "Negativo")
  ) %>%
  select(Mes, `P&L USD`, `Retorno`, Trades, `Win Rate`, Resultado)

# Totales
total_pnl <- sum(trades$pnl_usd)
```

```{r tabla}
kable(monthly, booktabs=TRUE, align=c("l","r","r","c","c","c"),
      caption="Rendimiento mensual — ORB SPY") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options=c("hold_position","striped"),
                            font_size=10, stripe_color="gray!10") %>%
  kableExtra::column_spec(1, width="4cm") %>%
  kableExtra::column_spec(6, color=ifelse(monthly$Resultado=="Positivo","green!60!black","red"))
```

\vspace{0.8cm}

**Resumen:**

```{r resumen}
library(dplyr)
resumen <- trades %>%
  mutate(year = year(as.Date(date)), month_num = month(as.Date(date))) %>%
  group_by(year, month_num) %>%
  summarise(pnl = sum(pnl_usd), .groups="drop") %>%
  summarise(
    `Meses totales`    = n(),
    `Meses positivos`  = sum(pnl > 0),
    `Meses negativos`  = sum(pnl <= 0),
    `Mejor mes`        = sprintf("%+.2f (%.1f%%)", max(pnl), max(pnl)/CAPITAL*100),
    `Peor mes`         = sprintf("%+.2f (%.1f%%)", min(pnl), min(pnl)/CAPITAL*100),
    `P&L total`        = sprintf("%+.2f", sum(pnl)),
    `Retorno total`    = sprintf("%+.1f%%", sum(pnl)/CAPITAL*100)
  )

kable(t(resumen), booktabs=TRUE, col.names=c("Valor"),
      caption="Resumen general") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options=c("hold_position"), font_size=10)
```
